6-Verb Protection

        
Every AI action falls into one of 6 verbs. Kasbah intercepts all of them.

        
SEND
Messages sent to AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
✓

        
PASTE
Clipboard content pasted into AI tools
✓

        
UPLOAD
Files uploaded to AI platforms
✓

        
BROWSE
URLs and web content shared with AI
✓

        
DOWNLOAD
Content received from AI tools
✓

        
EDIT
File changes made by AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
✓

      


      
      

        
OS-Level Monitors

        
Guard Service
Local HTTP engine on port 8788 — processes all decisions on-device
✓ Active

        
Clipboard Monitor
Scans clipboard every 30ms for passwords, keys, and personal data
✓ Active

        
File System Watcher
FSEvents watcher on Documents, Desktop, and Downloads
✓ Active

        
TF-IDF ML Classifier
4-class statistical model: benign, PII, secret, injection (97.7% accuracy)
✓ Active

      


      
      

        
Security & Cryptography

        
Ticket Signing
HMAC-SHA256 signed tickets — every decision is cryptographically verified
✓ HMAC-SHA256

        
Replay Protection
Single-use tickets with DashMap tracking — no ticket can be reused
✓ Enabled

        
Audit Chain
Hash-chained SQLite log — tamper-evident, exportable, HMAC-signed
✓ Intact

        
Default Policy
Fail-closed architecture — unknown actions are DENIED by default
✓ DENY

Authority

      
Cryptographic proof that YOU are in control of AI on this device


      
      

        
What is Authority?

        

          Authority is a cryptographic binding that proves you — and only you — control what AI can do on this machine.
          When you claim authority, Kasbah generates an HMAC certificate tied to your identity.
          Every ticket and decision is signed against this binding.
          Reclaiming revokes all active bindings and resets control to you.

Authority Scope

        

          
READ — Can scan files & clipboard

          
WRITE — Blocked (AI can't write)

          
NETWORK — Can intercept sends

          
CLIPBOARD — Can monitor pastes
